glossary.note: 钢铁雄心4 术语对照表。翻译时严格遵守，保证全站译名一致。

style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

units.en: Manifests - global, continuous goal that used to give faction a modifier or a rule depending on the conditions. They are defined in ⟦0⟧ Example of those conditions can be conquered land or countries that have your ideology. In comparison to goals you can't change manifest in game also manifests is set in templates of faction and every faction supposed to have one.
⟦0⟧ - id of your manifest, must be unique.
⟦0⟧ - decide whether it's goal or ⟦1⟧. By default set to no (so it's a goal). Mandatory for manifests
Manifests only other arguments is ⟦0⟧ and regular ⟦1⟧, to see about ⟦2⟧ check this section ⟦3⟧.
⟦0⟧ = { } - is a block where you can add multiple progress_sections. Basically worse version of ratio progress. Don't use it

Rules - set of regulations used inside of faction. Rules can define how faction operates, as well as just give modifiers based on current rule applied. Rules have their own type and groups. Types define in which situation the rule is applicable and what scope will be used. Groups used to combine same purpose rule into one category. ⟦0⟧. Rules can be defined in ⟦1⟧
Rule won't show up unless it's added to at least one rule group
⟦0⟧ - id of your rule, must be unique.
⟦0⟧ - decides type of your rule, can be anything but game uses these predetermined tokens for in game faction rules.
Checks whether a country can join the faction
ROOT = joining country, FROM = faction leader
ROOT = country declaring the war, FROM = target country
Checks who can call to war
ROOT = country calling to the war, FROM = target country
Checks whether a member can change faction goals (note documentation might be wrong)
Checks which country can become the faction leader
ROOT = country that becomes the faction leader
Supposed to contain a list of peace_action_modifiers to apply during a peace conferences
⟦0⟧- is a ⟦1⟧ block that continuously checks every frame if a condition was met, required to make the rule to be visible in the rule list screen.

⟦0⟧ - is a ⟦1⟧ block that continuously checks every frame if a condition was met, required to make the rule available to be chosen in the rules list. If conditions aren't met the rule wouldn't be possible to select, but difference with visible is that it will still be visible and display why it's not available to be selected when hovered over.
⟦0⟧ - is a ⟦1⟧ block that decides if the rule can be removed, if currently active. Default scope is faction leader. By default is true, so rule is allowed to be deleted.
⟦0⟧ - is a ⟦1⟧ block that used to define the rule. For example is_major = yes inside the block will make it so only major countries would allow to use this rule.
⟦0⟧ - special ⟦1⟧ block that used to define whether government in exile allowed in faction or not.
⟦0⟧ - special ⟦1⟧ block that used to define who can be kicked out of faction. Works exactly same as trigger but used to define who can be exiled from faction.
⟦0⟧ - ⟦1⟧ a block that all members gets while a rule is active.
⟦0⟧ - special block that gets available if peace_conference_rules type is active. Used to apply modifier during peace conferences. Peace action modifiers can be found in ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧
Enable trigger will not run for the modifier - the modifier is enabled as long as the rule is active.
⟦0⟧ - is an ⟦1⟧ block that executes effects for the rule.
⟦0⟧ decides on how likely ai will chose this rule, works exactly same as all other ai_will_do blocks in the game. For more information check ⟦1⟧

Rule groups - used to combine same purpose rule into one category. They are defined "common/factions/rules/groups". It's recommended to have all rules inside one group of same type. However it's not mandatory. Also it's not required for one group to contain all rules of same type.
⟦0⟧ - id of your group, must be unique.
⟦0⟧ - used to define rule that's would be used by default in group
⟦0⟧ - list of rules in this group, you can define rules right there which is not recommend.

Members upgrades - is mechanic used in factions, that can be changed by faction leader. Only thing it's impacts how much manpower each faction members contributes towards shared manpower pool that can be used to garrison needed manpower. ⟦0⟧
It's recommended to have 4 members upgrade in one group, since it's default value that interface made for.
⟦0⟧ - id of member upgrade, should be unique, block used to create new instance
⟦0⟧ - ⟦1⟧ key for visible name of faction member upgrade. Not required, by default used group name
⟦0⟧ - ⟦1⟧ key for a visible description of faction member upgrade. Not required, by default used group description
⟦0⟧ - the icon that will be displayed while active. Will override the group's icon
⟦0⟧ - The amount of faction initiative that it cost to replace this upgrade with another
⟦0⟧ - A numerical value to dictate the amount manpower country contributes
⟦0⟧ - id of member upgrades group, should be unique, block used to create new instance
⟦0⟧ - ⟦1⟧ key for visible name of faction member upgrade.
⟦0⟧ - ⟦1⟧ key for visible description of faction member upgrade
⟦0⟧ - The icon that will be displayed while active.
⟦0⟧ - The faction upgrades within this group, this list will be sorted on their bonus
⟦0⟧ - Currently only supported type, others won't show up, can be used to overwrite default one.
⟦0⟧ - used to set default member upgrade. ⟦1⟧
Note: upgrade that chosen as default should be included in upgrades block

Faction templates - the way to combine all mentioned above things, plus add customization (name, icon). Templates can be used for two purposes, first: make predetermined faction template (e.g. Axis, Allies, Comintern), second: create a blank template for faction (e.g. fascist countries faction, south-American countries faction).
⟦0⟧ - ⟦1⟧ key for a visible name of faction.
⟦0⟧ - [GFX definition or direct path to image] - logo of the faction visible in the game. ⟦1⟧

Note: factions logo icons are strip of two logos in one file with size of 200x100, with each taking 100 pixels, so interface definition of logo must contain noOfFrames = 2, as any other image of game with stripped frames. As well as logo must have miniature definition with same name and addition _miniature at the end.
⟦0⟧ - color of faction used in faction map mode, by default uses faction leader color, must be specified in RGB as in other parts of the game.

⟦0⟧ - setting that allows this faction leader to join another faction, if set to yes leader can't leave faction unless he dismantles it, if set to no leader can leave, previous faction get destroyed and all members get invited to the new faction
⟦0⟧- is a ⟦1⟧ block that continuously checks every frame if a condition was met, required to make the template to be visible in the faction creation screen. ⟦2⟧
If left empty template won't show up in faction creation screen

⟦0⟧ - is a ⟦1⟧ block that continuously checks every frame if a condition was met, required to make the template to be chosen in the faction creation screen. If conditions aren't met the template wouldn't be possible to select, but difference with visible is that it will still be visible and display why it's not available to be selected when hovered over.
⟦0⟧ - faction manifest set for this faction. For more info see ⟦1⟧
⟦0⟧ - a block where you can set the default goals, there's could be only 3 goals of different types, goals can be defined inside the block or can be specified existing goal id. For more info see ⟦1⟧
⟦0⟧ - a block where you can set the default rules of faction, this block overrides default rules in the group. For more info see ⟦1⟧
create_faction - creates a faction without a template (OBSOLETE)
create_faction_from_template - the new fancy way of creating factions
add_to_faction - adds a country to a faction
remove_from_faction - removes a country from a faction
leave_faction - removes the current country from faction
set_faction_rule - sets a rule on a faction
add_faction_goal - adds a goal to a faction
remove_faction_goal - removes a goal from a faction
add_faction_power_projection - adds power to the faction
add_faction_influence_score - adds influence to the country in the faction
add_faction_influence_ratio - adds influence to the country based on the given ratio of the faction's total influence
faction_manifest_fulfillment - compares the current country faction's manifest fulfillmens to a value
has_faction_template - checks if the current country is in a faction created from a template
faction_power_projection - compares the current country faction's power to a value
faction_influence_score - checks influence value of current country in the faction
faction_influence_ratio - checks influence ratio of current country in the faction
faction_influence_rank - checks influence rank in the faction of the current country
has_faction_goal - checks if the current country's faction has an active or completed goal
has_completed_faction_goal - checks if the current country's faction has completed a goal
faction_goal_fulfillment - checks goal fulfillment for the current country's faction
has_manpower_to_become_leader - checks if the current country exceeds the current faction leader and its subjects in deployed manpower
has_industry_to_become_leader - checks if the current country exceeds the faction leader in number of factories
faction_influence_war_score_factor - war score modifier for faction influence
faction_influence_industrial_capacity_factor - industrial capacity modifier for faction influence
faction_influence_garrison_support_provider_factor - garrison support provider modifier for faction influence
faction_influence_garrison_support_reciver_factor - garrison support reciver modifier for faction influence
faction_influence_expeditionary_force_provider_factor - expeditionary force provider modifier for faction influence
faction_influence_expeditionary_force_reciver_factor - expeditionary force reciver modifier for faction influence
